scope: Major muscles and functional groups commonly referenced in general adult hypertrophy and resistance-training education.
methodology: Manually curated structure-and-action summaries linked to the SportRX movement atlas, representative local catalogue IDs, and reviewed source/claim records.
source_policy: Source pages are cited but not copied into the corpus. OpenStax full text is not ingested into an LLM or redistributed by SportRX.
content_boundary: Educational anatomy only; no diagnosis, activation percentage, exercise ranking, individual suitability or training dose.

records.origin_summary: Clavicle, sternum and upper costal cartilages across broad clavicular and sternocostal attachments.
records.insertion_summary: Proximal humerus at the lateral lip of the intertubercular groove.
secondary_actions: shoulder flexion contribution from clavicular fibers
records.role_in_training: Primary chest contributor in horizontal pressing and adduction-dominant movements; regional emphasis can vary with arm path but is not quantified here.
records.limitations: Broad attachment summary; pectoralis minor and fiber-level regional hypertrophy are not represented as separate dose targets.

records.origin_summary: Lower thoracic and lumbar spine through thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest and lower ribs.
records.insertion_summary: Proximal humerus at the floor of the intertubercular groove.
records.role_in_training: Major shoulder extensor and adductor in vertical pulling, with contribution to many horizontal pulls.
records.limitations: Does not quantify contribution across grips, torso angles or individual techniques.

records.origin_summary: Occipital region, nuchal ligament and spinous processes of the cervical and thoracic spine.
records.insertion_summary: Clavicle, acromion and spine of the scapula.
records.role_in_training: Different regions contribute to shrugging, rowing and overhead scapular motion; one exercise should not be described as complete trapezius isolation.
records.limitations: Upper, middle and lower regions are not assigned separate validated hypertrophy doses.

records.origin_summary: Lower cervical and upper thoracic spinous-process region.
records.insertion_summary: Medial border of the scapula.
records.role_in_training: Contributes to scapular retraction in horizontal pulling; catalogue rows cannot isolate rhomboids from trapezius and posterior shoulder contributors.
records.limitations: Grouped record; major and minor are not separately measured or programmed.

records.origin_summary: Lateral surfaces of the upper ribs.
records.insertion_summary: Anterior surface of the medial border of the scapula.
records.role_in_training: Contributes to reaching, pressing and overhead scapular motion; ordinary push-up labels do not quantify serratus loading.
records.limitations: The current catalogue lacks a reviewed serratus-specific exercise family.

records.origin_summary: Lateral clavicle.
records.insertion_summary: Deltoid tuberosity of the humerus.
records.role_in_training: Primary shoulder contributor in vertical pressing and a secondary contributor in horizontal pressing.
records.limitations: Exercise technique changes contribution; pressing sets are not converted into fixed fractional anterior-deltoid sets.

records.origin_summary: Acromion of the scapula.
records.insertion_summary: Deltoid tuberosity of the humerus.
records.role_in_training: More directly represented by lateral-raise tasks, with contribution to overhead pressing.
records.limitations: No arm path or resistance profile is ranked as universally superior.

records.origin_summary: Spine of the scapula.
records.insertion_summary: Deltoid tuberosity of the humerus.
records.role_in_training: Represented by posterior-shoulder movements and contributes to horizontal pulling.
records.limitations: Scapular movement can shift loading toward upper-back muscles.

records.origin_summary: Scapular fossae and lateral border across supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis.
records.insertion_summary: Greater and lesser tubercles of the humerus around the shoulder capsule.
secondary_actions: initiation or assistance of shoulder abduction depending on muscle
records.role_in_training: Contextual stabilizer group in upper-body movement; external-rotation exercises are not automatically rehabilitation prescriptions.
records.limitations: Grouped for education only; pain, instability and rehabilitation require separate clinical assessment.

records.origin_summary: Coracoid process and supraglenoid region of the scapula through short and long heads.
records.insertion_summary: Radial tuberosity and forearm fascia through the bicipital aponeurosis.
records.role_in_training: Directly covered by elbow-flexion tasks and contributes to pulling; shoulder position changes length across the long head.
records.limitations: Long- and short-head hypertrophy are not estimated from curl name or grip alone.

records.origin_summary: Anterior distal humerus.
records.insertion_summary: Coronoid process and tuberosity of the ulna.
records.role_in_training: A primary elbow flexor across forearm positions; curl variations do not isolate it completely from other elbow flexors.
records.limitations: The atlas does not assign a validated grip-specific brachialis stimulus score.

records.origin_summary: Lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus.
records.insertion_summary: Distal radius near the styloid process.
primary_actions: elbow flexion in neutral forearm position
secondary_actions: returns forearm toward neutral from pronation or supination
records.role_in_training: Commonly emphasized in neutral-grip curl tasks and contributes to pulling.
records.limitations: Neutral grip does not make the movement an isolation test.

records.origin_summary: Infraglenoid scapula and posterior humerus across long, lateral and medial heads.
records.insertion_summary: Olecranon of the ulna.
secondary_actions: shoulder extension and adduction contribution from long head
records.role_in_training: Directly covered by elbow extension and contributes to pressing; overhead position changes long-head length but does not guarantee regional growth.
records.limitations: Head-specific hypertrophy is not predicted from one exercise label.

records.origin_summary: Broadly from the medial elbow and anterior forearm bones across superficial and deep flexors.
records.insertion_summary: Carpal bones, metacarpals and phalanges through multiple tendons.
records.role_in_training: Direct wrist-flexion work and gripping demands both involve the group but represent different tasks.
records.limitations: Grouped record; individual finger and wrist muscles are not separately programmed.

records.origin_summary: Broadly from the lateral elbow and posterior forearm bones.
records.insertion_summary: Metacarpals and phalanges through multiple extensor tendons.
records.role_in_training: Direct wrist-extension work complements flexion and gripping tasks.
records.limitations: Grouped record; the catalogue does not cover all hand and finger functions.

records.origin_summary: Pubic crest and pubic symphysis.
records.insertion_summary: Xiphoid process and costal cartilages of upper ribs.
records.role_in_training: More directly represented by controlled trunk-flexion tasks and contributes to resisting trunk extension.
records.limitations: Abdominal exercise does not support spot-reduction claims or spinal diagnosis.

records.origin_summary: External surfaces of lower ribs.
records.insertion_summary: Linea alba, pubis and iliac crest through broad aponeurotic attachments.
records.role_in_training: Contributes to rotation and anti-rotation tasks as well as lateral trunk control.
records.limitations: Rotation direction and bilateral function are simplified for a catalogue-level explanation.

records.origin_summary: Thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest and inguinal region.
records.insertion_summary: Lower ribs, linea alba and pubic region.
records.role_in_training: Works with the external oblique in rotation, anti-rotation and lateral trunk tasks.
records.limitations: Surface movement does not isolate internal from external oblique activity.

records.origin_summary: Lower ribs, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest and inguinal region.
records.insertion_summary: Linea alba and pubic region through broad aponeurotic attachments.
crosses_joints: no single limb joint; acts across abdominal wall
records.role_in_training: Part of trunk bracing and pressure management; it is not isolated or clinically assessed by a generic plank label.
records.limitations: No claim of selective activation, spinal protection or pain treatment.

records.origin_summary: Broad posterior attachments from pelvis and sacrum into lumbar and thoracic vertebral regions.
records.insertion_summary: Ribs, vertebral processes and cranial attachments across iliocostalis, longissimus and spinalis columns.
records.role_in_training: Contributes to trunk extension and isometric control in hinges, rows and loaded standing tasks.
records.limitations: Grouped record; catalogue exercises do not diagnose weakness or back-pain mechanisms.

records.origin_summary: Iliac crest and iliolumbar region.
records.insertion_summary: Twelfth rib and upper lumbar transverse processes.
records.role_in_training: Contributes to lateral trunk tasks and resisting lateral flexion.
records.limitations: Side-bending or carrying performance is not a diagnostic test of this muscle.

records.origin_summary: Anterior inferior iliac spine and superior acetabular region.
records.insertion_summary: Tibial tuberosity through the quadriceps tendon, patella and patellar ligament.
records.role_in_training: Biarticular quadriceps component; hip position can affect muscle length during knee-extension tasks.
records.limitations: The record does not prescribe hip angle or infer regional hypertrophy.

records.origin_summary: Greater trochanter and lateral linea aspera region of the femur.
records.insertion_summary: Tibial tuberosity through the quadriceps tendon, patella and patellar ligament.
secondary_actions: patellar tracking contribution through quadriceps mechanism
records.role_in_training: Contributes to knee extension in squat, leg-press and knee-extension families.
records.limitations: Stance width or foot position is not used to promise selective growth.

records.origin_summary: Intertrochanteric line and medial linea aspera region of the femur.
records.insertion_summary: Tibial tuberosity through the quadriceps tendon, patella and patellar ligament.
secondary_actions: patellar tracking contribution through quadriceps mechanism
records.role_in_training: Contributes to knee extension across knee-dominant and direct knee-extension tasks.
records.limitations: SportRX does not claim selective VMO isolation or knee-pain treatment.

records.origin_summary: Anterior and lateral shaft of the femur beneath rectus femoris.
records.insertion_summary: Tibial tuberosity through the quadriceps tendon, patella and patellar ligament.
records.role_in_training: Deep quadriceps contributor to knee extension; not individually inferred from external exercise form.
records.limitations: No exercise in the catalogue is labelled as isolated vastus intermedius training.

records.origin_summary: Ischial tuberosity for long head and posterior femur for short head.
records.insertion_summary: Head of the fibula.
records.role_in_training: Covered through both hip-hinge and knee-flexion families; the short head does not cross the hip.
records.limitations: Long- and short-head regional hypertrophy are not predicted.

records.origin_summary: Ischial tuberosity.
records.insertion_summary: Medial proximal tibia through the pes anserinus region.
records.role_in_training: Biarticular hamstring contributing to both hip-hinge and knee-flexion tasks.
records.limitations: The atlas does not rank hinge or curl variants for this muscle.

records.origin_summary: Ischial tuberosity.
records.insertion_summary: Posteromedial proximal tibia.
records.role_in_training: Biarticular hamstring contributing to both hip-hinge and knee-flexion tasks.
records.limitations: The atlas does not rank hinge or curl variants for this muscle.

records.origin_summary: Posterior ilium, sacrum, coccyx and associated fascia.
records.insertion_summary: Iliotibial tract and gluteal tuberosity of the femur.
secondary_actions: hip abduction or adduction contributions by regional fibers
records.role_in_training: Major contributor to loaded hip extension across bridge, hinge and squat-related tasks.
records.limitations: No single movement is declared the best gluteus-maximus exercise.

records.origin_summary: External surface of the ilium.
records.insertion_summary: Greater trochanter of the femur.
secondary_actions: hip internal or external rotation depending on fiber region
records.role_in_training: Contributes to direct hip-abduction tasks and frontal-plane control in single-leg work.
records.limitations: Single-leg performance is not a diagnostic test of gluteus medius function.

records.origin_summary: External ilium deep to gluteus medius.
records.insertion_summary: Greater trochanter of the femur.
records.role_in_training: Contributes with gluteus medius to abduction and pelvic control; not isolated by catalogue labels.
records.limitations: No direct SportRX measure distinguishes medius from minimus contribution.

records.origin_summary: Pubic and ischial regions across adductor longus, brevis, magnus and related medial-thigh muscles.
records.insertion_summary: Medial and posterior femur with additional distal attachments depending on muscle.
crosses_joints: some related muscles also cross knee joint
secondary_actions: hip flexion or extension contributions depending on muscle and joint position
records.role_in_training: Directly represented by hip-adduction tasks and contributes to squat and single-leg patterns.
records.limitations: Grouped record; no clinical groin assessment or muscle-specific dose is provided.

records.origin_summary: Posterior aspects of the medial and lateral femoral condyles.
records.insertion_summary: Calcaneus through the Achilles tendon.
records.role_in_training: Biarticular calf muscle whose length and contribution change with knee position; often represented in straight-knee calf raises.
records.limitations: Straight-knee work does not completely isolate gastrocnemius.

records.origin_summary: Posterior proximal tibia and fibula.
records.insertion_summary: Calcaneus through the Achilles tendon.
records.role_in_training: Single-joint plantar flexor that remains active with the knee flexed; seated calf raises provide a distinct setup rather than perfect isolation.
records.limitations: Bent-knee work does not completely exclude gastrocnemius or establish an optimal hypertrophy method.
